skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn this image into a smooth drone flyover video with zoom and pan motion...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Image to Video Drone Shot skill.
- Instantly turn uploaded images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC up to 200MB) into smooth drone-style videos with AI-powered zoom and pan motion.
- No pro editing experience needed—just describe the desired motion and export 4K MP4s in about 30–60 seconds.
- Built-in credit system and anonymous token authentication for easy trial access.
- Designed for creators, real estate marketers, and anyone wanting cinematic drone footage from still photos, without needing an actual drone.
